description: Use this when the user wants to know where a product is on offer in Italy this week, at what price, at which chain and until when, and you need filters or sorting: a city or the position of the user, specific chains, a price cap, lowest price, lowest price per kg or nearest store first. Searches the offers currently valid in the flyers (volantini) of Italian supermarkets, discount stores and electronics chains. Flyers are local: with the city or the coordinates of the user the answer keeps the chains with a store near them; without a place it covers the whole country. Product names are in Italian: pass Italian words in `query` ("caffè", "pasta barilla", "lavatrice"). Returns price, previous price, the conditions printed with it (loyalty card, minimum purchase), brand, pack size, price per kg or litre, department, chain, validity dates, the page of the flyer and the link to the offer on prezzinvista.it; with a city or coordinates, also the distance, address and opening hours of the nearest store of each chain. Covers Italy only: not for other countries, not for online-shop prices. Flyer prices are indicative; the price displayed in store prevails. In hosts that support MCP Apps the results are also shown to the user as cards with photo, price and link.

city.description: Italian municipality (comune) to search around: where the user is, or the place they ask about, e.g. "Milano", "Reggio Emilia", "Sesto San Giovanni". Only flyers valid in stores within radius_km of its centre are returned. Without a place the search covers all of Italy.

discounted_only.description: Only offers whose flyer states a higher previous price.

latitude.description: Latitude of the position of the user (WGS84, decimal degrees), together with longitude. Distances are then measured from this point, and only flyers valid in stores within radius_km of it are returned. Takes precedence over city. Used for this answer only, never stored.

longitude.description: Longitude of the position of the user, together with latitude.

max_price_eur.description: Only offers at or below this price.

near_me.description: Whether to search around the approximate position of the user that some clients share with the call (ChatGPT does). When omitted, that position is used if the call names no city and no coordinates. true: the same, and the answer is an error when no position came with the call. false: all of Italy.

query.description: Product to look for, in Italian. Brand and product words are combined ("olio extravergine monini"). Omit to browse the biggest discounts.

radius_km.description: How far to look around the city centre or the coordinates, in km (default 15).

sort.description: relevance (default with a query), price (lowest first), unit_price (lowest price per kg or litre first; only offers that state it), discount (biggest first; default without a query), nearest (closest chain first; needs a city or coordinates).

stores.description: Only these chains, by name: e.g. ["Lidl", "Esselunga"].

name: search_flyer_offers

chains_searched.description: How many chains have a current flyer that was searched: with a city or coordinates, those valid there. No offer among 3 chains and no offer among 50 are different answers

city.description: The municipality the search was limited to: the one passed, or the nearest to the coordinates

distances_from.description: What distance_km is measured from: the coordinates passed, the approximate position shared by the client (near_me), or the centre of the city

nearest_stores.description: With a city or coordinates: for each chain in the offers, its nearest store, closest first

open_now.description: Open at the time of the answer (Italian time), when the hours are known

opening_hours.description: Weekly hours in Italian day abbreviations, when the chain publishes them: "lun-sab 8:30–20:00 · dom 9:00–13:00"

availability.description: With a city or coordinates: verified_nearby = the chain lists a store within radius_km; nationwide_flyer = the flyer is valid in the whole country, a store nearby is not verified

brand.description: Brand, written the same way across chains; absent when the name does not state one

category.description: Store department, in Italian: tells pasta from "Pasta del Capitano" toothpaste

conditions.description: What the flyer prints next to the price, in Italian: loyalty card required, minimum purchase, price for several pieces. The price holds under these conditions

distance_km.description: How far the nearest store of the chain is, from the place in distances_from

flyer_edition.description: For a regional or single-store edition of the flyer: the territory it is valid in. Absent when the flyer is the same for the whole country

flyer_page.description: Page of the flyer where the price is printed

name.description: Product name as printed on the flyer

official_flyer_url.description: The flyer on the website of the chain, where the price can be checked at the source

previous_price_eur.description: Price before the offer, when the flyer states it

price_doubt.description: Present only when something makes this price, or its discount, doubtful: what and why. It is a reason to check the flyer page before relying on the number, not a correction

quantity.description: Pack content as a number, in quantity_unit: "2x250 g" is 0.5

requires_loyalty_card.description: true when the conditions say the price needs the loyalty card, app or coupon of the chain. Absent otherwise: the flyer may not say

size.description: Pack size as printed, e.g. "2x250 g"

url.description: The offer on its flyer page at prezzinvista.it: the page of the flyer with the price on it

valid_from.description: First day of the offer, YYYY-MM-DD

valid_until.description: Last day of the offer, YYYY-MM-DD

place_assumed.description: true when the call named no place and the search was limited to the position shared by the client

radius_km.description: The radius searched around the place, in km

source.description: Who to credit for the data

typical_price.description: For everyday products: the typical (median) price in all Italian flyers this week, to judge the offers against

change_note.description: When there is no percentage: how this week compares with the week before

change_percent.description: This week against the week before, only when the change is clear

url.description: The price trend page on prezzinvista.it

updated_at.description: When the flyers were last read (ISO 8601). They are read again every three hours

title: Cerca offerte nei volantini
